title: A Review of Deep Learning Methods for Irregularly Sampled Medical Time Series Data

title: Recurrent Neural Networks for Multivariate Time Series with Missing Values (GRU-D)
authors: Che et al (Che, Purushotham, Cho, Sontag, Liu)
relevance_notes: Seminal GRU-D for informative missingness; masking + time interval; evaluated on MIMIC-III/PhysioNet; 2168 citations; baseline against which mixed models should be compared

title: Set Functions for Time Series (SeFT)
authors: Horn et al (Horn, Moor, Bock, Rieck, Borgwardt)
relevance_notes: Alternative to RNN/ODE: set-function view of irregular time series; scalable and parallelizable; competitive on healthcare datasets

title: Joint Modeling of Longitudinal and Survival Data in Public Health and Biomedical Research: A Systematic Review
venue: Int J Environ Res Public Health
relevance_notes: Recent systematic review of joint longitudinal-survival models; summarizes advancements in handling informative dropout/measurement error

title: Joint models in big data: simulation-based guidelines for required data quality in longitudinal EHR

title: Benchmarking with MIMIC-IV, an irregular sparse clinical time series dataset
relevance_notes: Adversarial: provides actual benchmark on MIMIC-IV for recent DL tabular time series models; shows performance landscape but comparison to mixed models limited

title: Uncertainty of risk estimates from clinical prediction models: rationale, challenges, and approaches
authors: Riley et al (Riley, Collins, Kirton, Snell et al)

title: Transparent Reporting of a Multivariable Prediction Model (TRIPOD) Statement
